notes.title: LoFi Music mode. Sleep mode.
notes.content:
Vortle now comes with an original LoFi soundtrack and a music player mode that works offline!. 

Also, a sleep mode with soothing rain sounds was added to the app.

notes.title: Vortle has improved controls and better graphics.
Tree movement in breathing scene. Better UX. Fixed lag in figure matching game.
notes.content: See the trees move with the breathing! Improved resolution of textures in the scenes. Fixed lag in the figure matching game. Improved performance!, New feature in breathing scene - trees move with the breathe. Bug fixes. UI/UX improvements.

notes.title: Box Breathing!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41517991/ea6d1eca2f7617979b4a09032682efc8be3306d3.png[/img]

Released a beautiful scene with an optional breathing exercise. The scene has a soothing forest sound as a background, so it is perfect for a meditation or mindfulness practice.

[i]Box breathing, also known as square breathing, is a technique used when taking slow, deep breaths. It can heighten performance and concentration while also being a powerful stress reliever. It’s also called four-square breathing.[/i] [url=https://www.healthline.com/health/box-breathing][source][/url]
